mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 40% of instances during FEDFUNDS decline periods, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 9.5% for two consecutive months, it signals severe labor market deterioration that triggers risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 35% of UNRATE > 9.5% consecutive months instances, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based demand contraction, triggering corporate revenue revisions and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Negative return signal fails in >50% of HOUST and RSAFS decline instances, or joint Rank IC < 0.01 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL growth > 2.5% YoY), the Federal Reserve tightens policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in <30% of high inflation instances, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months signals robust economic activity that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth fails to correlate with positive 5-day SPX returns in >40% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) falls below 1.0% annualized, it signals economic slowdown that triggers risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in <35% of GDPC1 growth < 1.0% annualized instances, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Negative return signal fails in >50% of PAYEMS decline and UNRATE rise instances, or joint Rank IC < 0.01 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In housing boom regimes (HOUST > 550.0), strong housing activity drives consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in <45% of HOUST > 550.0 instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.
